history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A detailed, high-angle shot captures a Free Fire "Standing Point" leaderboard against a dramatic, fiery red and black background. The Free Fire logo, in its signature white font, is prominently displayed in the top left corner. Below it, the bold white text "STANDING POINT" dominates the upper portion of the image. Underneath, smaller white text reads "FTBULEJAWA".

The central focus is a table displaying player rankings. The table has columns for "NAMA TEAM", "B", "K", and "POINT". Each row is numbered from #1 to #12, with the first 10 rows populated. The player names are listed in the "NAMA TEAM" column, followed by numerical data in the "B", "K", and "POINT" columns. For example, #1 has the "NAMA TEAM" "nickname" with "B" 1, "K" 48, and "POINT" 71. #2 lists "6.STAR,KIE" with "B" 0, "K" 35, and "POINT" 52. #3 shows "2.ES.MOJ1" with "B" 1, "K" 30, and "POINT" 51, and so on, down to #10 with "3.L1ONEL." and "B" 0, "K" 2, "POINT" 7. Rows #11 and #12 are empty.

The background is a visually intense composition of abstract fiery elements and a menacing character. A large, dark, demonic-like figure with glowing orange eyes, horns, and armor is positioned on the right side of the image, partially obscuring the leaderboard. Jagged, fiery red and orange textures fill the space behind the table and the character, creating a sense of intense heat and action. The overall lighting is dramatic and high-contrast, with the bright white text and numbers of the leaderboard standing out against the dark, fiery backdrop. The color palette is dominated by deep reds, oranges, black, and white, evoking a mood of intense competition and digital warfare. At the bottom left, a URL "gridplay.my.id" is visible, and at the bottom right, "Powered by" is followed by several small, stylized logos. The style is sleek, modern, and indicative of a gaming event or esports broadcast.
